channel.title: PAGASA VISPRSD Advisories
channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA VISPRSD

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 02:00 PM 17 August 2026

Light to Moderate with occasionally Heavy rains are expected over #Antique(AniniY, Barbaza, Belison, Bugasong, Culasi, TobiasFornier, Hamtic, LauaAn, Libertad, Pandan, Patnongon, SanJose, SanRemigio, Sebaste, Sibalom, Tibiao, Valderrama), #Aklan(Ibajay), #Palawan(SanVicente and Roxas) within the next 2 to 3 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #OccidentalMindoro, #Palawan(Busuanga, Coron, Culion, ElNido, Taytay, Linapacan, Araceli, Dumaran, Cuyo, Magsaysay, Agutaya, Cagayancillo), #Antique(Caluya), #Aklan(Malay, Buruanga and Nabas) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 05:00 PM Today.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 13 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 13 #VISPRSD
Issued at 03:09 PM 17 August 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Palawan(Busuanga and Culion) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Palawan(Coron), #OccidentalMindoro(Magsaysay and SanJose) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
